messages:
Nadia (CS): Quick check-in for Blueglen private VPC cutover. Customer reported a couple of 502s to their internal object-store during nightly backups and called out renewal sensitivity if we can't show stable tail latency. Opening CS-8422.

Ethan R: Pulled ELB + NATGW metrics 1: 02:08-02:14 UTC cluster of 502/504s. Retransmits spike then. Could be PMTU or a backend KMS burst. Need their tunnel MTU and exact backup start.

Samir (NetOps): Their on-prem tunnel MTU is 1500; path tests show drops above ~1420. We can test MSS clamp to 1400 tonight. Will schedule a short clamp window and report.

Priya S: KMS note: Blueglen rotates keys at 02:10 and backups start 02:12. That overlap can trigger heavy decrypt calls and transient latencies. Options: shift rotation 30m later, stagger backup role, or enable short decrypt caching on backup runner. Which would they prefer?

Nadia (CS): Actions: 1) @Samir run test MSS clamp and upload short pcap to CS-8422; 2) @Ethan attach ELB + natgw graphs to ticket; 3) @Priya draft KMS rotation FAQ + cross-account audit snippet. If we see >5% latency variance over baseline mark renewal_risk and loop AM.

Ethan R: Uploaded graphs and a 20s capture to CS-8422. Evidence points to PMTU blackhole for packets >1400B. Please ask their net team to enable MSS clamping or set tunnel MTU to 1400.

Samir (NetOps): Applied temporary MSS clamp 1400 for test window. Early telemetry shows retransmits down ~75% in the 30m sample. Will monitor during next backup window and post results.

Priya S: Drafted KMS FAQ blurb in the ticket: "If backups read objects immediately after rotation, expect transient decrypt latency. Recommend shifting rotation after backups or using a warm-cache for backup role." Added placeholder IAM/KMS JSON for audit-forwarding.

OnboardBot: Ticket CS-8422 updated  assignees: Ethan R, Samir (NetOps), Priya S. Status: monitoring. Next automated reminder in 12h.

Nadia (CS): Customer feedback captured: they want a one-page "pre-cutover network + KMS checklist" and a short FAQ on rotation/backups. I'll add renewal_risk flag if variance persists after next window. Please keep customer-facing updates in CS-8422 rather than extended Slack threads. Thanks!
